environment: Disposable local PostgreSQL with minimal Auth stand-in; labelled fictional fixtures only

checks.name: Existing agreed plan, costs and every readiness response survive the migration
Only two reviewed existing function bodies change; auth and all other behavior remain
Signed-out lifecycle endpoint is denied
Unverified identity cannot manage trips
Cross-trip metadata and mutations are denied
Joined member cannot archive a shared trip
Unknown or forged actor fields are rejected
Explicit acknowledgement is required
Stale trip revision cannot remove a trip
Shared agreed trip cannot be deleted as an unused draft
Editable 1–100 minimum and 1–365 duration values persist through workspace readback
Database rejects unsupported or fractional setup values
A genuinely unused organiser-only draft is deletable
Draft deletion is recoverable and idempotent without removing records
Changed action cannot reuse a delete receipt
Deleted draft cannot accept new private input
Deleted draft restores to collecting without reviving agreement
Even an unused invitation makes the trip shared, requiring archive
A saved private draft is preserved through archive instead of unused deletion
Archive preserves the author’s saved private input
Archiving preserves shared history and makes earlier agreement historical
Members retain their own saved input and archived shared workspace
Lifecycle metadata does not expose raw briefs or budgets
Restored shared plan requires fresh review and cannot reuse earlier readiness as agreement
Immutable version bytes remain unchanged through archive and restore
No direct trip update grant is introduced
Internal unused-trip helper is not client callable
Group collection can exceed the earlier eight-member cap
Concurrent lifecycle changes serialize and reject the stale action
A supported one-person plan can publish without the old four-person table constraint
